name: Elanco Animal Health Incorporated
moat_justification: Real #2/#3 franchise with brands and vet-channel reach in 90+ countries and a delivering innovation pipeline (Zenrelia, Credelio Quattro), but it plays behind Zoetis's scale, the Bayer-purchased portfolio keeps taking impairments ($1,042M goodwill in 2023, $47M intangible in 2025), reported gross margin has been flat in the mid-50s for five years, and GAAP returns on capital are weak (roic_proxy not computable — no operating-income tag filed; GAAP net losses in 2021, 2023, 2025 under ~$680M/yr acquisition amortization).
fragility_flags: STALE_FY: latest fiscal year ended 10 months ago — check TTM/quarterly OE and consider --base-oe-ps override
OE_VOLATILE: OE/share range over the last 5 yrs spans >3x — normalized base helps but the business is cyclical; widen bear weight
NI_OCF_DIVERGENCE: net income and operating cash flow differ by >40% in 2023, 2025 — find the one-off (tax deposits, impairments, WC swings) before trusting the OE base
SHARES_FALLBACK: no diluted share count filed for 2016 — those history years use the basic / outstanding / dei count recorded in the shares_tag column; per-share history there is approximate
WIDE_SCENARIO_SPREAD: super-bull IV is 4.2x super-bear IV — uncertainty is huge; confidence should not be high
HIGH_NET_DEBT: net debt is 11.6x normalized OE — levered OE can vanish fast; stress the bear cases
one_liner: Improving #2 animal-health franchise, moat 4/10 — real innovation-led growth (Q2 2026 revenue +10.2%, guidance raised) but TTM owner's earnings of $0.60/share behind $3.47B net debt cannot support $23.55 (weighted IRR 5.6%, IV@15% $5.66); clears 15% only under ~$5.66.
moat_for: Established brands and veterinarian-channel relationships across 90+ countries
Innovation pipeline delivering: Zenrelia largest single contributor to Q2 2026 global growth; Credelio Quattro in >50% of U.S. clinics
Reported gross margin stable mid-50s for five straight years (55.2/56.6/56.3/54.9/55.0% FY21-25); adjusted GM expanding (58.1% Q2 2026)
Diversified revenue: Pet Health 49% / Farm Animal 50%, U.S. 47% of sales
moat_against: #2/#3 position behind Zoetis, which outspends it on R&D and owns the category's strongest franchises
Purchased moat keeps eroding: $1,042M goodwill impairment 2023, $47M marketed-product intangible impairment 2025
Legacy parasiticide brands face generic erosion
Farm-animal half of revenue rides livestock cycles and producer economics
Leverage (~3.1x net debt/adj. EBITDA) and ~$680M/yr acquisition amortization constrain returns on capital
